established: Recipe choice is a material determinant of the C2 direction and scientific conclusion: parent p=0.5 per-iteration recipe yields null 0.5275 > observed 0.3 (C2 FALSE, ordering LESS stable than random) while new per-task weighted recipe yields null ~0.28 < observed 0.3 (C2 TRUE, ordering MORE stable than random). The conclusion completely reverses depending on recipe choice (result.json metrics, report.md Section 2)

The new per-task weighted recipe is robust across seeds (SD=0.0117 < 0.05), across 3 RNG implementations (max cross-RNG diff 0.0024), and produces consistent C2 direction (TRUE for all 10 seeds). The reversal is not a seed or RNG artifact (result.json metrics M2, M10-M13, M20)

Parent recipe null mean reproduction shows 2.3% deviation (0.5394 computed vs 0.5275 stored): F3 threshold of 0.001 is too strict for cross-Python-version reproducibility. Root cause is unsorted set iteration (PYTHONHASHSEED) + estimator mismatch (direct 499500 pairs vs sampled 10000 pairs), not script bug (audit V1)
